explanation: The statement concerns TauCeti's own Schwarz–Christoffel machinery (`schwarzChristoffelCompactifiedBoundary`, `schwarzChristoffelPolygon ... .edgeSet`, `schwarzChristoffelVertex`), none of which exists in Mathlib. Grepping Mathlib for `SchwarzChristoffel`, `schwarzChristoffel`, `prevertex` and `edgeSet` turns up only the unrelated `Polygon.edgeSet` in `Mathlib/Geometry/Polygon/Basic.lean`, the Schwarz lemma, and Cauchy–Schwarz inequalities; there is no Schwarz–Christoffel mapping theory in Mathlib. The proof itself is built entirely from other library lemmas (`schwarzChristoffelCompactifiedBoundary_injective_iff`, `..._of_edge_intersections`, `schwarzChristoffelPolygon_bounded_edges_adjacent_and_eq_vertex_of_injOn`, etc.), so there can be no Mathlib duplicate.
